body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: e82ca1d2d995a5c328bb28f204e81ae90fed224f -->
Review: clean (safety tier, read-only: the diff was read, not built; it relies on the author's quick gate at e82ca1d2d).

1. The law (`crates/app/src/operation/first_traverse.rs` `table_read`)
- The worst start for `axis_z < 0` is the lowest reading along the axis. The move from it to the plane drops `(plane - low) * -axis_z` in the world. The refusal is `drop - stroke > Z_TOL`, the same tolerance and sign as the up-axis arm.
- `limit = low + stroke / -axis_z` is correct. At the limit the drop equals the stroke, so the named repair ("lower the clearance plane to Z<limit> or under it") passes.
- A horizontal axis (`axis_z = 0` or `-0.0`) gives a zero drop. The arm returns `Clear` before the division, so no division by zero is possible.
- Two verdicts stand together when the plane is between the limit and the stock top. Observation, not a blocker: when the limit is under the stock top and the plane is over the stock top, only the "lower" verdict shows. After that repair, the "raise" verdict shows. Both states refuse the post, so this is not unsafe. Decision item 3 says a little more than the code does. A P7 follow-up can name "no plane is clear" in one verdict.

2. The verdict (`crates/sim/src/verify/types.rs`)
- `FirstTraverseUnderTable` is not in the advisory list of `blocks_post`, so it blocks the post.
- It is in each exhaustive match: Display, `warned_moves.rs`, `mcp/job.rs` (`first_traverse_under_table`), `ui/src/operations.rs` key and `last_move`.
- Fold key 224 is used by no other arm on main and by no open PR. A scan of all open PR diffs found 224 only in this PR. Small error in the PR body: #2836 uses key 217 for `UndercutLift`, not 222. This does not change 224.
- Serde: the enum is externally tagged (`rename_all = "snake_case"`), and the new variant is additive. An old project cache loads without change.

3. The stamp salt (`crates/app/src/operation/stamp.rs`)
- A tilt frame exists only when `params.tilt()` is `Some` (`OpFrame::of` -> `tilt.and_then(|t| t.frame())`). The salt is necessary because the post gate trusts the cached warnings. It is also sufficient: each cache that the old law judged with a frame reads Stale one time. Untilted caches do not change.

4. Examples: `git diff origin/main...e82ca1d2d -- examples/` changes only 7 operation `stamp` fields in the three projects. No `.nc` file changes.

5. The proof that the verdict blocks
- The refused test asserts the cached verdict, `blocks_post`, the text, the absence of "raise", and that the post is refused. In that rig the Z-stroke law also refuses the post, so no test shows that this verdict alone stops the post.
- This is not a blocker. The post gate (`posting.rs:1291`, `posting_sim.rs:176`, `script/api.rs:283`) filters each cached warning by `blocks_post`, with no per-kind arm. The test pins the two inputs of that filter: the cached verdict and `blocks_post() == true`.
- Recommended P7 follow-up: a rig in which the face stays inside the Z stroke, so that only this verdict refuses the post.

6. Code shape
- No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` in non-test code.
- No check is weaker: the old note did not block, and the new verdict blocks.
- `crates/ui/src/operations.rs` (647 lines) and `crates/sim/src/verify/types.rs` (484 lines) were over 400 lines on main before this PR. This PR adds 4 and 13 lines. The split is earlier debt, not a blocker.

Decision file and premise: `docs/decisions/3081-table-down-axis-verdict.md` uses the #2987 premise (b), with the start at the Z travel top. It states that a program that starts low is not covered. This agrees with the maintainer's premise.

Ready and merge: the coordinator flags head e82ca1d2d ready and merges it. Review: the Opus safety-tier review (comment 7053548122, marker on e82ca1d2d, clean; the two notes are #3094, P7). Gate: the batch tier on the merged tree (b5e4e1bae = this head + main c5f4e6f94, local, Windows): 1010 steps, 0 failed; the light tier is green. The three shipped projects change only in their operation stamps (the class the maintainer accepted for #2965); no .nc changed. Heavy lanes: not run, covered by the cut gate.
